thought: The Slack action parameters are missing, so I need to define them to send a message to the 'general' channel with the proper text extracted from input data.
plan: Set select to 'channel' to send message to a channel.
Set channelId mode to 'name' and value to 'general'.
Set messageType to 'text' and text to '={{$json["text"]}}' to send the message text from input_data.
criticism: Without proper Slack params, the message cannot be sent. The params must include channel and text with expression to extract from input_data.

tool_input.comments: Send message to Slack channel 'general' with text extracted from input data.
